headline: India's IT minister says the government will publish a consultation paper on AI rules within a month.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: the full article was read; the timing is a minister's statement, and no paper is out yet.
importance_line: What changed: India plans a public consultation on AI rules within a month, covering safety, skills, deepfakes and the possible psychological effects of AI. People who use AI and the companies that build it would be affected, but no paper is out yet.
summary: Moneycontrol reports that Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on 8 Oct 2026 that the government will release a consultation paper on AI regulation within a month, and that the paper will set the basis for India's approach. The paper is to cover safety, inclusive skilling, deepfakes and possible psychological effects of AI, and Vaishnaw said that 'the bulk of the responsibility has to be on industry'.
